title: Projective Geometry
description: What a painter sees: parallel lines meet at the horizon, and lengths change, but straight lines stay straight.

puzzle.goal: A camera has its screen a length f behind a pinhole and sees a thing of height H at a range Z. Write how tall its image I is.
puzzle.name: Perspective
puzzle.ask: Find I for f = @{f}, H = @{H} and Z = @{Z}.
puzzle.method: Similar triangles through the pinhole: I/f = H/Z. Twice as far, half as tall.
